content_sections.heading: C-DOT Intern Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The Paid Internship Scheme at C-DOT invites eligible engineering students for R&D work at C-DOT campuses at Delhi/Bengaluru. This page covers the winter batch 2027. The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Paid Internship Scheme at C-DOT (winter batch 2027)
B.Tech/BE (EC/CS) student of a top 30 NIRF-ranked engineering institute, CGPA 7.0 out of 10 / 70% or above
Consolidated stipend of Rs. 50,000/- per month
Shortlisting by eligibility, academic background and demand; interview panel informed by email

content_sections.heading: About C-DOT
content_sections.text: C-DOT describes itself as a premier Telecom Technology R&D Centre of Govt. of India, with its campus at Mehrauli, New Delhi-110030. The objective of the Paid Internship Program is to attract young talent from the top 30 engineering institutes as per NIRF ranking for interning at C-DOT for R&D work. It gives young scholars an insight into the related technical work and possible future employment.

content_sections.heading: C-DOT Intern Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The closing time is not printed in the notice. Interns are generally inducted twice each year, during Summer and Winter, based on requirement.

rows.event: Winter batch starts (onwards, based on C-DOT requirements)

content_sections.heading: C-DOT Intern Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The total number of interns to be engaged is a maximum of 50 per year, and a maximum of 5 interns will be selected from one institute for internship in a calendar year. The final vacancy position may vary, and offers will be issued based on the final vacancy position at the time of final selection.

content_sections.heading: C-DOT Intern Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Second-year exams must be completed and the results declared; the current semester should be between 5 and 8. Minimum CGPA 7.0 out of 10 / 70% or above in B.Tech/BE, as on the last semester for which result has been declared. Possessing the minimum qualifications does not guarantee an internship. Candidates with exposure in the area of intended internship and a good academic background are given preference. Only students of the listed 30 colleges may apply, and must select their own college from the drop-down list during registration. A candidate can apply for internship only once during his/her course. Candidates should check the official notification for the list of the 30 institutes and the branch-wise eligibility details.

rows.qualification_required: Indian student of a top 30 engineering institute as per the latest NIRF Ranking, studying Computer Science or Electronics & Communication or an equivalent branch relevant to C-DOT (i.e. AI, Data Science, ML, IT etc), in B.Tech/BE (EC/CS).

content_sections.heading: C-DOT Intern Salary 2026
content_sections.text: In addition to the stipend, interns may use basic facilities like the C-DOT canteen at subsidized rates.

rows.pay: Consolidated stipend of Rs. 50,000/- (Fifty Thousand Only) per month, subject to mandatory attendance requirement

content_sections.heading: C-DOT Intern Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates are contacted via email; the list/panel of shortlisted candidates for interview is informed through individual e-mails. Offers are based on eligibility, academic background and demand. C-DOT publishes the final results on its website at the conclusion of the recruitment process. Final offer letters are sent by e-mail to selected candidates and their respective institutes. C-DOT will not entertain any query regarding the recruitment/selection process and will not correspond with candidates about reasons for non-selection.

content_sections.heading: Duration and Terms of the Internship
content_sections.text: The internship lasts a minimum of three months and a maximum of one year. Interns not completing the minimum requisite period will not be issued any certificate. For final-year students, the internship duration in the No-Objection Certificate must not go beyond the last working day of the last semester of the course. The scheme also allows a semester to be completed at C-DOT based on R&D work, with supervision from both C-DOT and the institute. The internship is at C-DOT campuses at Delhi/Bengaluru.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for C-DOT Intern Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the C-DOT Paid Internship site, https://paid-internship.cdot.in . First-time users click Register and enter Name, Email, Institute, Degree, Semester and CGPA/Percentage. Verify the email with the OTP to complete registration. Existing users log in with the registered email and password. Go to Apply and upload the required documents. Check all fields carefully and submit the form. Only one application per candidate is allowed. The application is treated as complete only when the form is completed in all respects, final submission is done and the confirmation mail is received. Applicants can withdraw an application by logging in, clicking Withdraw Application and confirming it. CV/Resume (mandatory, to be uploaded under the Additional Documents section) Academic marksheets Photograph Institute No-Objection Certificate (NOC), duly signed by the Competent Authority of the Institute

content_sections.heading: C-DOT Intern Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Have all required documents ready before starting, and verify all personal, academic and internship-related details, including internship start and end dates, before final submission. Selecting any college other than your own, or misusing the drop-down options, leads to immediate rejection of the application at any stage. Incorrect entry of degree, current semester, CGPA or percentage during registration results in immediate rejection. The NOC period should cover the entire duration of the internship. An application with an unsigned NOC will be rejected. If the form is not submitted by the closing date and time, or is incomplete, the candidature will be summarily rejected. For queries on the application process, write to [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many interns will C-DOT engage?
faq.answer: C-DOT will engage a maximum of 50 interns per year, with a maximum of 5 from one institute in a calendar year. The final vacancy position may vary.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the C-DOT Paid Internship?
faq.answer: The portal for the winter batch 2027 is open from 19 November to 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the C-DOT internship?
faq.answer: Indian B.Tech/BE (EC/CS) students of the top 30 engineering institutes as per the latest NIRF Ranking, studying Computer Science, Electronics & Communication or an equivalent relevant branch, can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum CGPA required?
faq.answer: The minimum is CGPA 7.0 out of 10 / 70% or above, as on the last semester for which result has been declared. Second-year results must be declared and the current semester must be between 5 and 8.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for C-DOT interns?
faq.answer: Interns receive a consolidated stipend of Rs. 50,000/- per month, subject to mandatory attendance requirement.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the internship?
faq.answer: The internship is for a minimum of three months and a maximum of one year. Interns who do not complete the minimum period will not be issued any certificate.

faq.question: Q7. Is a No-Objection Certificate required?
faq.answer: Yes. A NOC signed by the Competent Authority of the institute, covering the entire internship duration, must be submitted at the time of application. Unsigned NOC applications are rejected.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply more than once?
faq.answer: No. Only one application per candidate is allowed, and a candidate can apply for internship only once during the course.

faq.question: Q9. When does the winter batch start?
faq.answer: The winter batch starts from 11 January 2027 onwards, based on the requirements of C-DOT.

faq.question: Q10. How will shortlisted candidates be informed?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are contacted via individual e-mails, and final offer letters are sent by e-mail to selected candidates and their institutes.
